summary: Skills collection bundling scripts with curl/ping usage; no traced installer harm
details: Package ships a collection of 'skills' (bundled scripts and helpers) under bundled-skills/. Static keyword co-occurrence hits fired on shell and Python helpers: bundled-skills/rclone-cli/scripts/install.sh line 15 runs 'curl https://rclone.org' as a documented installer for the rclone CLI; bundled-skills/youtube-notetaker/scripts/verify.sh uses curl/GET against documented endpoints; bundled-skills/junta-leiloeiros/scripts/*.py reference ping and HTTP GET/POST as part of a scraper/API helper; bundled-skills/loki-mode/benchmarks/run-benchmarks.sh references install/curl tokens in a benchmark harness. No lifecycle-script auto-execution path in package.json invokes these files on npm install; the scripts are user-invoked tooling shipped as skill assets. No hardcoded attacker C2, no installer-secret reads (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, env scraping), no obfuscation, no fetch-and-execute of remote code, and no import/install-time network activity is present in the flagged files. The curl to rclone.org points at rclone's own official project domain, consistent with the skill's stated purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
